visual.observation: A webpage branded with a Nike logo shows a survey flow after language selection and displays text requesting entry of a “15-20 Digit Survey Entry Code from your receipt,” with a code already visible in an input field.
visual.context: The page appears to be a Nike-themed customer survey interface; context is unclear from visuals alone.
visual.potential_relevance: A brand/endorsement presentation is linked to a requested action requiring a receipt survey code before continuing the survey.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether the site is officially affiliated with Nike, whether the code is valid, or what happened outside the shown survey flow.

visual.observation: Later in the survey, the page asks for contact information including first name, last name, and email address, with text stating privacy assurances and that a coupon may be received by email within up to 4 business days.
visual.context: The contact form appears within the same Nike-themed survey sequence; the page states it will not rent or sell the information and will not contact the user unless requested.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised coupon is linked to submitting personal contact information after completing the survey, with a stated email-delivery timeframe.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the coupon amount, whether the form was submitted, whether any email was received, or whether the privacy statement is accurate.

visual.observation: After the survey/contact form sequence, the browser shows a Nike retail-looking homepage with Nike branding, product navigation, and promotional panels.
visual.context: The page resembles a Nike shopping site interface; the transition from the survey to this page is visible only as sampled frames, not as a confirmed click or redirect path.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible sequence shows a Nike-themed survey followed by a Nike retail-looking destination, relevant to reviewing whether the survey’s promised or branded destination aligns with the subsequent page.
visual.limitations: Sparse sampling cannot prove how the page was reached, whether the domain is official, or whether any promised coupon was delivered or applied.

visual_context_notes.observation: Multiple survey pages show ordinary customer-experience questions about travel time to the store, purchase categories, reasons for purchase, fitting room use, and satisfaction ratings.
The contact-information page includes visible text stating: “Your privacy is very important to us. We will not rent or sell your information, and will not contact you unless you have requested it.”

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a tutorial for completing a receipt-linked Nike customer survey with ordinary questions about a store visit. The stated incentive is a $5 coupon or gift card for a future Nike purchase, although the evidence does not establish the site's official affiliation, coupon delivery, or the accuracy of its privacy statement.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary retail promotion in which a receipt-linked customer survey is presented as qualifying the participant for a coupon, gift card or stated discount toward a future Nike purchase.
